j4q.shaders

Class Shader

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.models.Component
      • j4q.shaders.Shader
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    Background360Shader, ColorPhongShader, ColorPickerShader, ColorShader, MatCapShader, NormalMapMatCapShader, NormalMapPhongShader, NormalMapShader, PhongShader, ShadedTextureShader, TextureNormalMapPhongShader, TextureShader

    public class Shader
extends Component
    Base class for OpenGL ES shader management and uniform handling.

    Provides methods for compiling shaders, setting uniforms, binding buffers, and rendering meshes.
